name: SLOC Triage
description: Resolve sloc-guard findings with focused refactors or justified exemptions
about: Triage file-size and directory-structure findings in GitHub repositories already using sloc-guard. Apply cohesive refactors, justified exceptions, or direct structural fixes, then verify changes and open a pull request; report cases needing a maintainer's decision.
features: Refactor files and folders along cohesive boundaries
Explain narrowly scoped exceptions to size limits
Verify changes and open a focused pull request
examplePrompt: Triage the sloc-guard findings in this repository. Make cohesive fixes, justify scoped exceptions, run the project's checks, and open a pull request for verified changes.
